method: Every source this pack rests on was fetched once on 2026-08-15 and its licence read off the source itself or off the project's own repository. Nothing was inferred from the kind of project it is: where a page states no licence, this file says so rather than assuming the usual one for that ecosystem. licence_state verified means a licence file or a governing specification of licensing was read directly; stated-unverified means the project states the licence somewhere authoritative but the licence file itself was not opened; not-stated means the source page carries no licence statement; no-reuse-licence means the terms shown grant the distributor rights and grant a reader none. Carried expression was checked by reading the whole read surface of the pack and scanning it for quoted spans.

carried_expression.note: No text from any source is reproduced anywhere in the read surface. Terms of art are named and then explained in our own words: the four repository roles, the release-age setting, the statement and predicate layers, the level numbers. No specification requirement text, no documentation sentence and no paper abstract is carried.

study_conduct.note: Nothing was installed, downloaded for execution or run. Every source was read as a web page. No page encountered during this research contained text addressed to an agent, and no page asked the reader to perform any action; if one had, it would be recorded here and in NOTES.md and would not have been acted on.

refused_access.consequence: The pack's position on what a bill of materials must carry rests on the CycloneDX specification and on the empirical study of generation quality, not on a government minimum-elements list. Nothing in the pack cites the list, and no claim about it is made.
